title.narrative: Balance Promoción para el Desarrollo y Juventud A.C.

description.narrative: "Balance Promoción para el Desarrollo y Juventud A.C. works to strengthen the Sexual and Reproductive Rights of young people, women, and non-binary people in Mexico. The organization contributes to the construction and support of the feminist movement from a diversity perspective and addressing its work from transversal strategic lines: Political Advocacy, Communication, Emancipation, Strengthening Leadership, and Movement Building. The grant will support the following priorities and specific activities: - Hiring and fair salaries for different programs and work areas - Generation of content in different formats, design, production, and distribution of informative materials - Strengthen Balance's emancipation and local movement-building strategy - Continue processes that strengthen holistic security such as having equipped and safe facilities; promoting the comprehensive well-being of the team; tools for compliance with legal, fiscal, accounting, and human resources regulations."
